Tom / Vanessa —

Quick technical notes to complement Vanessa's checklist:

- SOC 2: For the pilot we recommend "Infrastructure and application" in scope; TLS in transit + encrypted at rest (AES-256). We can provide control descriptions and latest SOC 2 Type II test window (Mar–Aug 2026).
- CAIQ: The attached workbook has answers for the majority of merchant queries; I'll add notes where we have compensating controls vs. exact criteria.
- Data retention: Default retention options are 30/90/365 days for caches and KV stores; customers can request tailored retention for embeddings and logs — any request requiring <30d or >365d will require a short technical review and possibly Dedicated/Private deployment.
- Evidence intake: I'll run the intake and can prepare an evidence owner matrix for each control area.

Small ask: Tom, please confirm whether MerchantCo requires proof-of-wipe / export scripts for the pilot data. If yes, we'll include a demo of the export and wipe flow in the intake.
